Folio

Sources and licences

Folio is free to use. The MIT licence applies to original software, not to every book, model, font or dictionary.

Original reader
MIT: Folio’s original code and original interface only.
Starter books
Text-only editions. The frozen catalog identifies each edition, source, language and author. Historical works and editorial contributions have distinct rights; no worldwide public-domain guarantee.
Research articles
Five adapted scientific reading editions under CC BY 4.0. For each paper, the authors, original DOI, journal and credit are in its final chapter.
English news
News is adapted from English Wikipedia Current Events. Every saved digest carries a dated source and its CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution. Any displayed Commons image carries its own credit.
Bergamot and Mozilla models
MPL 2.0. Model and runtime downloads are distinct. EN→RU and EN→HI are separate optional packs.
PDF.js
Apache 2.0. Embedded fonts, CMaps, JBIG2, JPEG2000 and colour handling have additional notices in the PDF.js directory.
Tesseract OCR
Worker, core, trained language assets and incorporated components have distinct notices. Bundled runtime credits · Source and digest inventory.
